transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, I'm here because things have been really difficult lately. My in-laws moved into our house, and ever since then, I’ve just been... so keyed up and completely worn down. 

It's spilling over into everything. I’m snapping at my wife a lot, which isn't like me. And at work—I'm a business manager for musicians—I'm avoiding calls that I would normally handle immediately. I actually nearly let a client's contract fall apart recently just because I couldn’t think straight. I just need some help getting back on track.
When did these keyed-up and worn-down feelings begin?
It's been going on for about a month now. Uh, yeah, right around the time my in-laws moved into our home. It pretty much started exactly when they got there.
Since your in-laws moved in, have you been feeling persistently down or hopeless?

No, I wouldn't say I feel down or hopeless. It's not really a sadness thing. Um, it's more just this constant tension. I'm just completely overwhelmed and on edge all the time, but I haven't been feeling hopeless about it.
Are your worries mainly about living with your in-laws, or do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different areas of your life?

Um, it's really just about them living with us. I don't find myself worrying about a bunch of other things like, you know, my health or finances or anything like that. 

The issues at work are just happening because I'm so distracted and drained by the situation at home right now. So, yeah, the worry pretty much all traces back to my in-laws being in our space and just feeling like I can't escape it.
